palette.primary_role: Text and backgrounds — spans dark-first (Shopify: #000000 void) to light-first (Nike: #ffffff canvas, Airbnb: #ffffff canvas). Black/near-black dominates as text color across all brands.
palette.accent_role: Singular brand accent used sparingly — Shopify Neon Green for focus rings only, Airbnb Rausch coral for primary CTA only, Nike Red for sale/error badges. Color is precious and never decorative.
palette.surface_role: Light surfaces (white, off-white, snow) for product-card contexts; dark teal surfaces for immersive brand moments (Shopify). Airbnb's Soft Cloud (#f7f7f7) for footer/subsection backgrounds. Nike's Light Gray (#f5f5f5) for input backgrounds.
palette.neutral_role: Secondary text, metadata, borders. Gray scale carries hierarchy below the accent color. Airbnb's Hairline Gray (#dddddd) is the universal 1px divider. Nike's secondary text (#707072) is the standard muted voice.
palette.border_role: Hairline borders for card separation, input outlines, dividers. Dark variants for dark-theme contexts (Shopify's #1e2c31). All brands use subtle borders rather than heavy strokes.

border_radius.sharp: 0px - 4px (product imagery — full-bleed, no radius on Nike/Airbnb hero photos)
border_radius.pill: 30px - 9999px (all CTA buttons — full pill is universal across e-commerce)
border_radius.typical_card: 8px - 14px (Airbnb listing cards at 14px, Shopify feature cards at 8-12px)

button_styles.text: action-oriented (Shop now, Reserve, Start free trial, Get started)
Learn more, Sign in, Watch demo

elevation.shadows: ranges from flat (Nike — zero shadows) to multi-layer stacked (Shopify, Airbnb)
elevation.approach: Nike is flat with zero shadows; Airbnb uses 3-layer stacked shadows for sticky panels; Shopify uses multi-layer shadows with inset white glow on dark cards

typical_order: header (sticky, logo left, nav center/right, CTA pill right, cart/account icons)
hero (full-bleed photography or dark cinematic bg + h1 + subtitle + primary CTA + secondary CTA)
category_navigation (horizontal scroll of category pills or image cards — 'Shop Men', 'Shop Women', 'New Arrivals')
product_grid (3-6 column grid of product/listing cards with photography, name, price, rating)
featured_collection (curated product showcase with lifestyle photography, brand story)
benefits (free shipping, returns, sustainability — icon + short text in a row)
promotional_banner (full-width dark strip with promo code, sale announcement, limited-time offer)
newsletter_cta (email signup, often with discount incentive)
cta (app download or loyalty program signup)
footer (4-6 column: shop categories, help, about, legal, social, payment methods)
hero_variants: full_bleed_photography (Nike style — edge-to-edge product/lifestyle photo, text overlay with dark gradient scrim)
dark_cinematic (Shopify style — black/teal void bg, ultra-light 96px headline, neon accent, product screenshot centered)
search_centered (Airbnb style — large destination search pill as hero focal point, background photography carousel)
split_image_right (text left 60%, product photo right 40% on warm background)
feature_card_variants: listing_card (photography top 4:3, no shadow, text metadata below — city/name, type, price)
product_card (square 1:1 photography, tight 4-12px grid gaps, name + price below)
category_image_card (full-bleed photography with text overlay, large touch target)
bento_product_grid (modular cards of varying sizes for featured collections)

tone_profile.headline_style: benefit-driven or product-assertion, 3-8 words (e.g., 'The global commerce platform', 'Just Do It', 'Find your next adventure')
tone_profile.cta_style: direct action verbs (Shop, Buy, Reserve, Book, Get started, Start free trial, Explore)
anti_patterns: no product photos above the fold

color_mood: dark_cinematic (Shopify: #000000 bg, deep teal surfaces, #36f4a4 neon accent, white text — luxury product-reveal aesthetic)
monochrome_athletic (Nike: #ffffff bg, #111111 text, zero UI color — product photography is the only color source)
warm_photography (Airbnb: #ffffff bg, #ff385c coral accent, soft gray borders, photography-driven warmth)
typography_mood: ultra_light_display (Shopify: NeueHaasGrotesk weight 330 at 96px — ethereal, cinematic headlines)
athletic_condensed (Nike: Nike Futura ND uppercase, 0.90 line-height — stadium-scoreboard bold)
single_family_warm (Airbnb: Airbnb Cereal VF weight 500 throughout — confident, friendly, single-voice)
layout_density: theatrical (Shopify: vast dark space between sections, 80-120px gaps, each section is a 'slide')
dense_retail (Nike: tight 4-12px product grid gaps, packed with product, maximalist choice display)
magazine_information (Airbnb: 24px card gutters, 4-8px internal metadata gaps, photography breathes, data is dense)

sections: product_hero (image gallery + product info + price + size/color selector + add_to_cart)
product_detail_page.best_practices: Image gallery with thumbnails, sticky add-to-cart on mobile, size guide modal, free shipping threshold indicator

category_page.best_practices: Horizontal filter pills, sort dropdown, grid/list toggle, quick-add to cart from grid

checkout_page.best_practices: Single page or 3-step, trust badges prominent, guest checkout option, mobile-optimized inputs
